name: OpenText Software Delivery MCP
description: Search, create and update backlog items, defects and stories in OpenText ALM Octane and ValueEdge from AI coding tools, through the MCP server built into the product.

skills.name: Query Work Items
skills.description: Lists defects, stories and other entities with filtering, keyword search, sorting and pagination, or retrieves one by identifier.

skills.name: Create Work Items
skills.description: Creates new entities such as user stories or defects in the workspace, scoped to the authenticated user's permissions.

skills.name: Update Work Items
skills.description: Updates selected fields on an existing entity, for example adding acceptance criteria to a story's description.

skills.name: Explore Metadata
skills.description: Lists entity types, their fields and field types, and the filter syntax and operators the workspace supports.
